authority.delegated_scope: Phase 0 design evidence only; no RED, GREEN, lifecycle write, session, member open, execution, or real activity.
authority.reason: The accepted ADR chronology has no current public owner seam capable of producing its port authorization, captured receipt, authorization set, then session order.

required_order: frozen consumer document and derived exact ConsumerCapturedPort
LifecycleCapturedReceipt.v2 for each matching port authorization
signed CapturedAuthorizationSet.v2 over the complete sorted entries
broker-signed nonserializable LaunchSession bound to the verified set
controlling_contract.packet_exit: Prove canonical ordering, exact descriptor/port/receipt/runtime/release equality, self-digest, duplicate/missing entries, post-freeze mutation, same-session misuse, and the valid publication-to-distinct-session path.

exact_shapes.canonical_rules: Exact closed objects; duplicate/missing/extra keys refuse. Signed self-digests hash deterministic canonical bytes with only self and signature omitted. Entries are strictly ascending and unique by planned_entry_sha256; cardinality is exactly one per PCE. Every set, entry, port, receipt, session, and runtime binding has byte-identical execution authority ref, logical execution ID, and run ID.

adjacency_ledger.equality: planned_entry_sha256 plus PEA/CES/BVP/CAS chain, study, subject, execution tuple; one authorization per PCE
consumer document, node, input, purpose and descriptor root/snapshot/document/node/output/purpose are exact; no caller-selected alternate projection
authority tag/digest, logical execution and run match; issuance atomically consumes the WORM admission before minting
complete execution tuple, subject, chain digests and planned entry; receipt names exact port authorization
exact predecessor schema/digest and resolved immutable PCE root; strictly increasing same-stream predecessor and WORM-unique nonce
exact measured actor_runtime_sha256 and lifecycle release identity; no runtime or release substitution
bijection by planned_entry_sha256; exact three digests; strict canonical order; no duplicate, missing, extra, or alternate resolved projection
complete P(CES)==P(BVP)==P(CAS)==P(Stage)==P(Captured), or the four replay pre-capture legs
study/execution tuple, consumer document, BVP, set self, measurement, purpose and bounded trusted time; set is verified before session mint
same nonserializable broker-bound identity; producer/same-run/same-session/restart substitution refuses before open/import/construction/output
exact basis and role/use per artifact, Ed25519, inclusive trusted time and fail-closed immutable revocation snapshot
recomputed document and descriptor bytes remain exact at every transition; mutation refuses before subsequent effect

public_LifecycleAuthority.observed: capture(published,frozen,port,**kwargs) and open_capture(session,captured) exist; no public issue-port-authorization, return-receipt, build/verify-set, or mint-session-after-set method exists.

development_capture.observed: derive_consumer_port recomputes the frozen document. capture validates it, creates and records a consumer LaunchSession at lines 1188-1201, then appends CAPTURED and returns captured/session.

development_receipt.observed: CAPTURED emits dskit.lifecycle-receipt/v1 with generic lifecycle fields and HMAC development signature. It is not the exact LifecycleCapturedReceipt.v2 object and is not returned by the public capture API.

historical_driver.observed: HistoricalStudyVerifier consumes its local one-use cell before delegating to LifecycleAuthority.capture; it neither issues CapturedPortAuthorization.v2 nor constructs/verifies CapturedAuthorizationSet.v2, and the delegated call exposes the already-created session.

current_main_seam_audit.frozen_boundary: Packet plan freezes F4 dskit/pipeline/trust.py and forbids a parallel lifecycle writer or bypass broker.

candidate_dispositions.would_require: The F4/core owner approves a versioned public broker seam that atomically consumes admission, issues port authorizations, records/returns exact v2 receipts, verifies/builds the complete set, and only then mints a set-bound session.
candidate_dispositions.status: requires design and ownership approval before RED

candidate_dispositions.would_require: F5a adds its own receipt/session authority beside LifecycleAuthority.
candidate_dispositions.status: refused: second writer/trust root and ownership violation

candidate_dispositions.would_require: Verify supplied port/receipt/set bytes without resolving the live published/frozen/captured/session objects.
candidate_dispositions.status: insufficient: proves grammar/signatures only and cannot satisfy exact live equality or valid path

candidate_dispositions.would_require: Equate generic lifecycle-receipt/v1 with LifecycleCapturedReceipt.v2 or hide/relabel the already-created session.
Modify dskit/pipeline/trust.py inside this F5a packet without an approved manifest correction.

future_red_matrix_after_approval: Every exact key, scalar, literal, self-digest, role/use, signature, time and revocation mutation for port, receipt and set.
Unknown/extra/missing/duplicate/unsorted entry and every P4-C01 through P4-C12 single-field substitution.
CAPTURED before frozen document/hash, prefreeze port, publish omission, descriptor mutation, wrong document/root/receipt, and runtime/release substitution.
Admission reuse, same producer/consumer run, same session, copied/wrapped/subclassed/serialized handle, restart identity, partial failure and retry.

Valid synthetic PUBLISHED -> frozen document -> exact port -> consumed admission -> port authorization -> v2 receipt -> complete signed set -> distinct set-bound session; no member open/import/construction/output before the last step.
No real provider, network, filesystem source, capture data, replay, backtest, paper/live, or deployment.

major.impact: Any implementation on current public seams must either create/expose the session before the verified set, use the wrong receipt schema, omit live equality, or create a forbidden second authority.
major.required_resolution: Obtain an explicit F4/core ownership decision and accepted versioned seam design; update the controlling manifest if trust.py ownership changes.

next_gate: Fresh Terra skeptic must validate the seam audit and blocker. If confirmed, stop before RED and request the explicit F4/core owner decision; do not invent authority.
